[[File:Seeker-FDCR.png|thumb|right|250px|A Togruta and Zabrak Jedi Seeker]]
'''Jedi Seekers''' were members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who traveled throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], assisting those who needed help and fighting the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] when they found it. Seekers occasionally discovered new [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|techniques]] and [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who needed training. Specializations of the Seeker included the [[Ataru Striker]], the [[Jedi Hunter (specialization)|Jedi Hunter]], and the [[Jedi pathfinder]].<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Operating far beyond the safety of civilized worlds and without any formal support network, these wanderers adopted an intensely pragmatic approach to their mission. Rather than relying solely on the Force, they viewed it as merely one tool among many, prioritizing extreme adaptability and resourcefulness above all else. In the uncharted wilderness, they learned to survive by analyzing unknown flora and fauna and improvising equipment from whatever was at hand. Whether they allowed fate to guide their path or integrated into larger groups as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Envoy/Legends|envoys]], and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], their success hinged on their ability to seamlessly adjust to changing environments and neutralize threats that festered in total isolation.<ref name="FDCR" />
